description: Webview side and packaging of the detail tab (depends on FEAT-002's detailProtocol.ts and detailHtml.ts ids): detailRender.ts (DomLike-based header/status/GOOS-select rendering), detail.ts entry (ready handshake, state/installed handling, sanitized innerHTML for README/Documentation only, README collapse toggle, link and fragment click delegation, GOOS change, Install/Uninstall button posting stub messages), media/detail.css using VS Code theme variables, esbuild third bundle, .gitignore/.vscodeignore updates, tests and packaging verification. See .agents/tasks/detail-tab-plan.md section 7.
steps: Create src/webview/detailRender.ts reusing the DomLike/NodeLike types exported from src/webview/render.ts. Export pure functions that build DOM from the model with createElement/createTextNode/setAttribute/replaceChildren only (no markup from strings): renderHeader(dom, headerEl, detail: PackageDetail, installed: boolean) producing: h1 title, chips, import path, version link, published, licenses, imports, imported by (links are <a href=absolute url> with class detail-link so the delegated click handler can post openLink), checks list (each item prefixed with a text marker '\u2713' / '\u2717' and visually-hidden text 'Yes'/'No' so state is not colour-only), repository and links, a 'View on pkg.go.dev' link to detail.pageUrl, and ONE button#detail-action (type=button) whose text is 'Uninstall' when installed else 'Install'; setInstalledButton(dom, buttonEl, installed) used by the 'installed' message; renderGoosSelect(dom, container, buildContext, current, disabled) building label 'Rendered for' + select#detail-goos with option per {value,label} and `selected` for current (omit entirely when buildContext is undefined); renderStatus(dom, statusEl, errorEl, model) for idle/loading/error text and the Retry button.

Create src/webview/detail.ts (entry, IIFE-bundled; follow the structure of src/webview/search.ts: acquireVsCodeApi, DetailToHost typed postMessage). On load post {type:'ready'}. Message listener validates shape (type 'state' with object state having string status, string path, boolean installed, boolean mainLoading; type 'installed' with boolean) and renders: idle -> placeholder 'Select a package from the Search view.'; loading -> status 'Loading <path>\u2026' with a loading bar element; error -> error text + Retry button (posts {type:'retry'}); ready -> renderHeader once per distinct detail object (skip re-render when only mainLoading/error/goos changed), main section built once per distinct detail: README section (title, content container whose innerHTML = detail.readmeHtml, toggle button) and Documentation section (title, GOOS select container, content container whose innerHTML = detail.docHtml); mainLoading -> add class 'is-loading' + aria-busy on #detail-main and disable the select; inline `error` with status 'ready' -> banner with Retry in main and select value reset to model.goos. README collapse: after setting innerHTML, if content.scrollHeight > 480 add class 'is-collapsed' and show toggle button (aria-expanded false); toggle flips class/aria-expanded/text ('Expand'/'Collapse'); no toggle when short. These are the ONLY two innerHTML assignments in the file, each with a comment that the HTML is host-sanitized (plan section 6).

In detail.ts add event delegation: click on #detail-header and #detail-main -> closest('a'): preventDefault; href starting with '#' -> scroll to document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(href.slice(1))) via scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) (ignore malformed escapes with try/catch); other href -> post {type:'openLink', url: href}; click on #detail-action -> post {type:'install'} when the button text state is Install else {type:'uninstall'} (track the boolean in a variable, not by reading text); change on select#detail-goos -> post {type:'changeGoos', goos: select.value}. No inline event handler attributes anywhere.

Create media/detail.css (tracked; style reference media/search.css): body padding and fonts from --vscode-font-family / --vscode-font-size / --vscode-foreground / --vscode-editor-background; #detail-header layout (title row with chips as bordered pills using --vscode-badge-*, meta list as definition-style rows, checks list with markers, repository/links, action button styled with --vscode-button-background / --vscode-button-foreground / hover --vscode-button-hoverBackground and --vscode-focusBorder focus ring, border 1px solid var(--vscode-contrastBorder, transparent)); .detail-link uses --vscode-textLink-foreground; loading bar (own copy of the .loading-bar keyframes from search.css) honouring prefers-reduced-motion; .detail-error uses --vscode-errorForeground with role=alert; #detail-main sections with titles and borders --vscode-editorWidget-border; README .is-collapsed { max-height: 480px; overflow: hidden } with a fade; scoped rules under .detail-main for scraped content: a, code/pre (background --vscode-textCodeBlock-background, font-family var(--vscode-editor-font-family), overflow-x auto), blockquote (--vscode-textBlockQuote-background / -border), table borders, img max-width 100%, h1-h6 sizes, .Documentation-index lists, .Documentation-declaration, .Documentation-source, details/summary. Never use fixed colours.

Modify esbuild.mjs: push a third config {entryPoints:['src/webview/detail.ts'], outfile:'media/detail.js', bundle:true, platform:'browser', format:'iife', target:'es2022', sourcemap:false, logLevel:'info'} next to the search one. Modify .gitignore: add `media/detail.js`. Modify .vscodeignore: add `!media/detail.js`, `sample-pages/**` and `.agents/**`.

Add tests: test/unit/detailRender.test.ts with a fake DOM like test/unit/render.test.ts (header shows Install when installed=false and Uninstall when true; setInstalledButton flips text; checks have text markers; GOOS select rendered only when buildContext present, selected option matches current, disabled flag; all values go in via text nodes - a title like '' stays a text node; link hrefs set verbatim); test/unit/detailView.test.ts for detail.ts with a fake document/window like test/unit/searchView.test.ts (posts ready on load; state message renders; installed message updates only the button; click on anchors posts openLink or scrolls for '#pd-x'; select change posts changeGoos; action button posts install/uninstall according to state; innerHTML only assigned for readme/doc containers). If detail.ts is not testable with the existing fake-DOM approach, structure it as an exported `startDetailView(doc, win, api)` called by a tiny bootstrap, mirroring how searchView.test.ts exercises search.ts - read that test first and follow it.

Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` (confirm media/detail.js and media/search.js are produced and `git status` does NOT list them) and `npx vsce ls` (must list media/detail.css and media/detail.js, and must not list sample-pages/ or .agents/). Fix everything. Record in findings the exact outcomes and that the manual F5 checklist from plan section 9 was NOT run (cannot be automated here). Commit locally staging explicit paths only, message `feat: render package detail webview with GOOS selector and install stub`.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` exit 0; build emits media/detail.js and media/search.js; git does not track media/detail.js
`npx vsce ls` lists media/detail.css and media/detail.js and does not list sample-pages/ or .agents/
Header model renders Install for installed=false and Uninstall for installed=true; clicking posts {type:'install'} / {type:'uninstall'} only (no other action)

The GOOS select appears only when detail.buildContext exists, its change posts {type:'changeGoos', goos}, and the main section shows a loading state while mainLoading and an inline error with Retry on failure
Anchor clicks never navigate the webview: '#pd-*' scroll inside the webview, everything else posts openLink
No inline scripts/handlers/styles in the shell; the only innerHTML assignments are the README and Documentation containers
media/detail.css uses only --vscode-* variables for colours
findings: Committed on branch feat/detail-tab (120559e, not pushed). VERIFICATION: `npm run typecheck` exit 0. `npm run build` exit 0 (emits dist/extension.js, media/search.js, media/detail.js 15.1 kb; git status does NOT list media/*.js). `npm test`: 618 passed, 1 failed; the single failure is the PRE-EXISTING test/unit/searchSmoke.test.ts 'media/search.css contains no hard-coded colors' (flags `border: 1px solid var(--vscode-contrastBorder, transparent)` in media/search.css, which this FEAT did not touch; same failure recorded in FEAT-001/002). New tests (36) all pass: detailRender (14), detailView (20), detailCss (2). `npx vsce ls` lists media/detail.css and media/detail.js and does NOT list sample-pages/ or .agents/ (only build.txt, package.json, dist/extension.js, imgs/*, media/.gitkeep, detail.css/js, search.css/js). NOT RUN: the manual F5 Extension Development Host checklist from plan section 9 (cannot be automated here), and npm run test:integration. FILES: src/webview/detailRender.ts (renderHeader returns the action button, setInstalledButton, renderGoosSelect, renderRetry, renderStatus, constants ACTION_ID/GOOS_SELECT_ID/RETRY_CLASS), src/webview/detail.ts (exported startDetailView(doc, win, api) plus a bootstrap guarded by typeof acquireVsCodeApi, so tests import it without side effects), media/detail.css, esbuild.mjs third config, .gitignore (media/detail.js), .vscodeignore (!media/detail.js, sample-pages/**, .agents/**). DEVIATIONS/DETAILS: (1) Click and change handling uses ONE delegated listener each on #detail-root (anchor -> preventDefault, '#...' -> scrollIntoView(decodeURIComponent), else openLink; .detail-retry -> retry; #detail-action -> install/uninstall by a tracked boolean; select#detail-goos change -> changeGoos); the README toggle has its own listener. (2) A hidden 'pendingGoos' keeps the select on the user's choice while mainLoading and resets to model.goos when the loading ends (covers the inline-error revert). (3) Main always starts with a banner (loading bar + inline error with Retry); README section only if readmeHtml, Documentation section if docHtml or buildContext, else 'No documentation is available for this package.'. (4) CSS: no fixed colours at all and no 'transparent' fallback (border colours use var(--vscode-button-border, var(--vscode-contrastBorder)) etc.), so the README collapse fade from the plan is replaced by a dashed bottom border (a fade needs a transparent colour stop); `[hidden]{display:none !important}` is defined because components set .hidden. (5) The loading state clears header and main (content of the previous package is not kept); the Install/Uninstall label is also refreshed on every ready state from model.installed. (6) The only HTML-property assignments in detail.ts are the README and Documentation containers (asserted by a source-level test). (7) README collapse measures scrollHeight at render time; if the panel is hidden at that moment scrollHeight can be 0 and the README stays expanded (accepted).
